brief: Index of the first array entry that passes a test
description: Call predicate for each entry of array, in index order, until it returns true, then return that entry's index. Entries whose value is undefined are included. If no entry passes, the result is -1.

parameters.description: The array to walk. A string is not walked as an array: write [...value] to walk its characters.
parameters.name: array

parameters.dataTypeParameter: (value: any, index?: integer, array?: array) => boolean
parameters.description: Returns true for the entry whose index to return. A script function is called with (value, index, array); a built-in function is called with the value alone, since its other parameters have their own meanings.
parameters.name: predicate

returns.description: The index of the first matching entry, or -1 if none match.
